items.item_text: 01. Information I provide to the following supplemental questions will be reviewed as part of the application process. Questions that are not fully and completely answered will be considered grounds for disqualification from the examination process. Stating "see resume" in lieu of a complete response to these questions is not acceptable. Select "Yes" to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes
02. Do you have a high school diploma or equivalent? Options: Yes | No
03. Do you have a valid California Driver's License (or an out of state license and are willing to obtain a California Driver's License upon offer of employment)? Options: Yes | No
04. How many years of verifiable job related experience do you have working in landscape construction? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more

05. How many years of verifiable job related work experience do you have performing the installation, repair, and maintenance of sprinkler and irrigation systems? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more
06. Do you have a valid Backflow Prevention Assembly Tester certification? Options: Yes | No

07. If you answered YES to the question above, return to the main application in the attachments section and attach a copy of your valid Backflow Prevention Assembly Tester certificate. Select YES to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions.] Options: Yes

08. According to the job announcement, check the box that most closely matches your level of proficiency to perform the minimum qualifications listed: Planning, laying out, assembling, and installing sprinkler and irrigation systems. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

09. Inspecting, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing sprinkler and irrigation systems. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

10. Measuring, cutting, threading and installing pipes, tubing and a variety of sprinkler and irrigation systems fixtures. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

11. Operating a variety of power equipment and tools. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

12. The questions below are designed to indicate whether you are willing to perform the duty listed. Check YES if you are willing to perform this duty or NO if you are not. Please keep in mind that all of the duties listed are REQUIRED of the position. If you are not willing to do any one of the duties listed, you will not be considered in the recruitment process. Select "YES" to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes
13. Walking over rough or uneven surfaces. Options: Yes | No
14. Lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling heavy objects. Options: Yes | No
15. Exposure to pesticides, fertilizers and chemicals related to landscape maintenance. Options: Yes | No
16. Fumes from vehicle and equipment operation. Options: Yes | No
17. Working around and with machinery having moving parts. Options: Yes | No
18. Working around underground utilities. Options: Yes | No
19. Electrical hazards associated with irrigation controllers. Options: Yes | No
20. Describe your experience inspecting, troubleshooting, and repairing sprinkler and irrigation systems. Include the types of systems and equipment you have worked with.

21. Describe your experience maintaining irrigation systems for athletic fields, parks, landscaped areas, or other large properties. Include the size and complexity of the systems you have maintained.

Plan, lay out, assemble, install, inspect, maintain, troubleshoot and repair District sprinkler and irrigation systems including mainline and lateral piping, valves, sprinklers, drip irrigation systems, controllers, wiring, quick couplers and related equipment; clean, adjust and repair sprinkler heads.

Maintain, repair, renovate and remodel new and existing irrigation systems, including valves, sprinklers, controllers and related equipment; maintain current knowledge of irrigation systems and related components.

Measure, cut, thread and install pipes, tubing and a variety of sprinkler and irrigation systems fixtures; wrap and insulate pipes as needed; excavate trenches and restore landscaped areas following repairs; repair broken main lines.
May assist with the installation or repair of backflow assemblies and pressure regulating devices.

Test irrigation systems for proper pressure, coverage and uniformity; test sprinkler and irrigation systems for leaks. Diagnose irrigation system failures including electrical, hydraulic, valve, controller, wiring and communication issues. Perform seasonal irrigation inspections and preventive maintenance. Monitor irrigation system performance and report deficiencies to supervision.
Review blueprints to assure compatibility and standardization of sprinkler parts, valves and pipes; design jobs; estimate time and cost of materials.
Complete work orders and document repairs using District software.
Operate a variety of power equipment and tools such as saws, forklifts, loaders, backhoes, jackhammers and trenchers; drive a District vehicle to and from work sites.
Communicate professionally with District personnel, vendors and outside agencies regarding irrigation repairs and service interruptions and to coordinate services; prepare purchase orders.
Assist with irrigation renovation and improvement projects.
Respond to emergency irrigation failures including water leaks, broken mainlines and controller failures as needed.
Perform related duties as assigned.
WORKING CONDITIONS:

KNOWLEDGE OF: Procedures, methods, techniques, materials, supplies, tools and equipment used in the installation, repair and maintenance of sprinklers and irrigation systems. Smart irrigation controllers and water management technology. Installation, maintenance and repair of irrigation systems. Building codes and other restrictions pertaining to sprinkler irrigation systems. Basic electrical troubleshooting related to irrigation systems. Water conservation principles and efficient irrigation practices. Safe excavation procedures and underground utility awareness. Health and safety regulations. Proper lifting techniques. Interpersonal skills using tact, patience and courtesy. Basic recordkeeping techniques.

Efficiently and effectively use a variety of hand and power tools and equipment used to perform skilled repairs of irrigation systems and sprinklers. Install, maintain and repair irrigation systems. Respond effectively to emergency irrigation failures. Work independently. Meet schedules and timelines. Observe health and safety regulations. Work from blueprints, shop drawings and sketches. Estimate materials and supply needs. Order parts and supplies according to established guidelines. Maintain accurate records. Work cooperatively with others. Understand and follow oral and written instructions.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a variety of hand and power equipment. Standing for extended periods of time. Walking over rough or uneven surfaces. Lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling heavy objects. Digging. Bending at the waist, kneeling or crouching. Reaching overhead, above the shoulders and horizontally. Heavy physical labor. Seeing to read and perform repair duties.
